# ConsentLayer - DPDP Act Compliance Platform

## Overview
ConsentLayer is an automated compliance auditing and consent governance platform designed exclusively for Indian healthcare providers, including SME clinics, diagnostic laboratories, and polyclinics.

## Core Problem Solved
Under the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act of 2023 (enforced 2026), Indian healthcare providers are classified as Data Fiduciaries. Mishandling digital patient records (e.g., sending unencrypted WhatsApp reports) or failing to take reasonable security safeguards can trigger Section 33 penalties of up to ₹250 Crores. ConsentLayer prevents this exposure.

## Key Features
* **Automated Privacy Audits:** Scans clinic workflows for WhatsApp distribution risks and endpoint vulnerabilities.
* **Section 33 Liability Modeling:** Real-time financial penalty exposure calculations.
* **Multilingual Consent Engine:** Digital consent collection aligned with the 8th Schedule of the Indian Constitution (English, Hindi, etc.).
* **Audit-Ready Artifacts:** Instant proof-of-compliance certificates for NABH auditors and insurance TPAs.

## Target Audience
Medical practitioners, clinical directors, pathology lab owners, and healthcare administrators in India.

## Pricing
ConsentLayer currently offers a Free Healthcare Pilot Program to deploy automated consent tracking at zero cost during the initial phase.
